description: Convert a public https RSS 2.0 or Atom feed URL to tidy markdown ($0.005 USDC via x402). https only — http, file, data, localhost, and private IPs are rejected. Caps: 1 MB body, ~10s timeout, max 5 redirects. Optional max_items (default 20, cap 50). Returns JSON { url, final_url, feed_title?, feed_link?, format, items, markdown, item_count, warnings }. Provided as is, with no warranty or guarantee of accuracy or fitness. Nothing is stored.

max_items.description: Max feed items to return (default 20, cap 50).

url.description: https URL of an RSS 2.0 or Atom feed. http/file/data/localhost/private IPs rejected.

name: rss-to-markdown
